detail: 只读审查 supporting diagnostic transport 的 committed 76d916b..17c65d8，以及诊断 source ec7b439/98c30de 和 workflow f111479，按 d6200799 已提交 spec 裁决。所有差异仅新增 diagnostic workflow、supporting spec 与两个新报告目录；原产品、依赖、旧 tests/fixtures、deploy-vps workflow、progress/features/human gate 字节未改。首次 instrumentation violation 保留在独立初版快照，98c30de/17c65d8 的最小修订闭合它：logger stat/append/serialization 和 health-sidecar 写入异常均在 catch 边界内，原 native 返回值/异常不被替换；child error 观察改用 errorMonitor，不再消费原来未处理的 error。独立父进程对 pending/failed/missing/invalid/unreadable trace health fail-closed 为 diagnosticCompleted=false，且明确不推导产品 cleanup 失败。诊断代码只使用新 synthetic HOME/temp、系统环境白名单和固定 fixture；不继承真实账户/代理/provider/NODE_OPTIONS 凭证，不打印原始事件、环境、命令参数或流内容，raw result 的 synthetic canary 扫描可拒绝归档；trace 仅记录受控 owned-path labels、长度、PID、状态和错误码。watchdog 仅针对尚未观测退出的直接 spawned diagnostic root PID，未对记录的旧 fixture PIDs 发信号；保留 40s/64KiB/约512KiB bounds、原 fixture 15s 自限和残留 fail-closed，不枚举或杀无关进程。workflow 的 trigger 与 job if 双重硬锁唯一精确 diagnostic branch，无 main/PR/glob；contents read、persist-credentials=false、immutable SHA 校验、Node22/fresh npm ci、12min、无 environment/Secrets/SSH/production/service 操作，非零退出原样失败。always upload 仅固定 provenance/result 和 native-output JSON/JSONL，不上传 source events/temp/profile/raw env。诊断 subtree unchanged transport 与 workflow unchanged bytes 已机械核对。此结论仅关闭 supporting scope；未执行 native Windows 或产品功能验收，不是发布 PASS，原 release Windows 8fail、OCI/deploy skipped、F004/F005 和 release_ready=false 未被软化。
measurement_limits: Preload tracing adds timing and I/O overhead; diagnostic observations are instrumented branch evidence, not uninstrumented performance or old-test acceptance.
Forced termination may leave trace health pending. Unknown completeness must remain diagnostic nonzero, not proof of product cleanup failure.
Recorded PID liveness can conservatively include PID reuse; no stale recorded PID is killed to hide a residue.
Only static source/diff/provenance were reviewed here. The reported macOS logger-only controls are retained implementation evidence, not independent native Windows acceptance.
write_scope: 仅新增初版 scope finding 和本最终 scope verdict；未修改产品、测试、原证据、状态或 commit。
